source.dataset: CELLxGENE Census kidney single-cell ADME matrix built by this project
source.normalization: CP10K (raw counts / obs.raw_sum * 1e4) then log1p; mean over all cells of the cell type (zeros included)

polarity_note: a renal tubular cell is polarised: the BASOLATERAL face meets the peritubular capillary (blood), the APICAL face carries the brush border and meets the tubular lumen (urine). Every transporter below carries its membrane face explicitly; drawing one on the wrong face would reverse the direction of transport.
no_flux_calibration: THERE IS NO CALIBRATED EXPRESSION-TO-FLUX CONVERSION in this project. Expression values are not turned into transport rates, clearances or concentrations anywhere. The mapping from the measured values to the colours and arrow weights in the scene is QUALITATIVE and ordinal only.

metformin.why_this_drug: metformin is excreted entirely unchanged and mostly by ACTIVE TUBULAR SECRETION, so the whole route is renal transport with no metabolic step — the clearest possible demonstration of this organ's drug handling

route.note: free metformin is filtered at the glomerulus; filtration is a property of the barrier, not of a transporter, so no gene is shown for this step
metformin is a small organic cation; OCT2 carries it from the peritubular capillary blood across the BASOLATERAL membrane into the tubular cell
MATE1 exchanges metformin for a proton across the APICAL brush-border membrane into the tubular lumen
MATE2-K is the kidney-specific MATE paralogue, also APICAL
metformin leaves in the urine UNCHANGED — it is not a substrate of any CYP and undergoes no measurable hepatic metabolism

metformin.cyp_interpretation: these are the MEASURED renal proximal-tubule values for the major hepatic CYPs. They are reported so the claim "metformin is not metabolised in the kidney" is backed by the data in this project rather than only by the literature. A non-zero value is a transcript measurement and is NOT evidence of metformin metabolism.

organic_anion_secretion.description: the classical probenecid-sensitive secretory route: basolateral OAT1/OAT3 pull organic anions out of blood, apical pumps push them into the lumen

absent_from_gene_panel.SLCO4C1: OATP4C1, basolateral uptake of cardiac glycosides
absent_from_gene_panel.SLC5A2: SGLT2, apical glucose reabsorption (the gliflozin target)
absent_from_gene_panel.AQP2: aquaporin-2, the vasopressin-regulated collecting-duct water channel

missing_layers.reason: the source is single-cell RNA. No renal transporter PROTEIN abundance is included, so none of these values can be read as a transporter density.

converting transcript abundance to transport capacity needs absolute protein quantification and in-vitro-to-in-vivo extrapolation. This project has neither, so no such coefficient exists and none has been invented.
no drug concentration, no renal clearance and no PBPK compartment is computed anywhere in this page.

the matrix is resolved by annotated CELL TYPE, which maps onto nephron segments for the tubule (proximal tubule, thick ascending limb, distal convoluted tubule, connecting tubule, collecting duct) but not onto S1/S2/S3 subsegments of the proximal tubule, where OAT and MATE expression is known to differ. Cell-type resolution is used as measured; no tissue average is substituted for it anywhere.
URAT1, OAT4, OATP4C1, OCTN1/2, SGLT2 and AQP2 are not on the panel this project built, so they are named in absent_from_gene_panel and NOT shown in the scene.
